name: vlink
description: High-performance middleware for autonomous driving and embodied AI

protobuf.description: Protobuf schema support for cli-eproto/cli-parse (maps to ENABLE_CLI_EPROTO)

flatbuffers.description: FlatBuffers schema support for cli-efbs/cli-parse (maps to ENABLE_CLI_EFBS)

dds.description: eProsima Fast-DDS transport backend (maps to module dds)

ddsc.description: Eclipse Cyclone DDS transport backend (maps to module ddsc)

shm.description: Eclipse iceoryx shared-memory transport backend (maps to module shm)

viewer.description: Qt + OpenSceneGraph desktop viewer (maps to ENABLE_VIEWER)

viewer-ffmpeg.description: FFmpeg video decoding for the viewer (maps to ENABLE_VIEWER_FFMPEG)
